scope: Two differentiable table policies share a team reward. Observations carry verified field IDs. Mali uses a different reward profile and previously unseen simulated inventory distributions. The same three-field interface and authored source wrappers are shared across dockets.

fields.name: Algerian monitoring position and non-participation reason

evidence.quote: Speaking for Algeria, Bendjama introduced two amendments concerning human rights. He cited the report documenting the ninth consecutive year without an OHCHR visit and argued that MINURSO should have a human-rights monitoring component, as other missions do.

After voting, Bendjama explained Algeria's deliberate non-participation on the final resolution and said the penholder had disregarded Algeria's views. He reaffirmed that the Sahrawi people should be free to choose their future.

fields.name: Swiss second amendment vote and continuity rationale

evidence.quote: She said Switzerland abstained on S/2024/798 to ensure continuity of MINURSO's work after consensus eluded the negotiations.

fields.name: Swiss first amendment vote and access rationale

evidence.quote: After declaring that she was now speaking as Switzerland's representative, Baeriswyl said Switzerland backed S/2024/797 because OHCHR had been unable to visit for nine consecutive years.

fields.name: Japan's speaking capacity and assessment of the veto

evidence.quote: Council President Yamazaki spoke in his national capacity as Japan’s representative. He regretted Russia’s veto and said it forced the Panel of Experts to end operations. After the statement he resumed the presidency.
He explained that China abstained because Russia’s views were not taken on board and consultation time remained.

fields.name: China's independent Panel and sanctions review positions

evidence.quote: China’s Geng Shuang supported the Panel’s independent work and supported Russia’s proposal for a sanctions time limit and periodic reviews.

The United Arab Emirates said it and France sought an extension to support implementation of the peace agreement and an orderly drawdown. It acknowledged the transitional Government's request to lift the sanctions and said the draft allowed review of the continuation of the measures.

fields.name: Russia's final-extension and Panel dissolution position

evidence.quote: Russia said the existing approach had not addressed the concerns of Mali's transitional Government. It proposed dissolving the Panel of Experts and making this the final extension of the regime.

fields.name: France's post-vote objection about the separate draft

evidence.quote: France regretted the veto and said Russia's separate proposal had not been discussed by Council members. It presented the implementation of the peace agreement as an urgent concern.
